scripts.build:vscode: node scripts/build-viewer.mjs vscode/viewer && npm run compile --workspace vscode
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:viewer && npm run compile --workspace vscode && node test/viewer-browser.mjs vscode && node test/viewer-browser.mjs jetbrains && node test/viewer-browser.mjs vscode test/fixtures/image-worker.pdf && node test/viewer-browser.mjs jetbrains test/fixtures/image-worker.pdf && node test/viewer-browser.mjs vscode --missing-image-worker && node test/viewer-browser.mjs vscode test/fixtures/sample.ofd && node test/viewer-browser.mjs jetbrains test/fixtures/sample.ofd
scripts.test:vscode-host: npm run build:vscode && node vscode/test/run-integration.mjs && node vscode/test/run-integration.mjs sample.ofd
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && npm run package --workspace vscode
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:vscode-host && npm run build:vscode
